puzzles.title: The back rank
hints: Look for a rook check on the back rank.
puzzles.explanation: The rook covers the back rank. The king’s own pawns block its escape.

puzzles.title: Working together
hints: Your king can protect the queen when she moves close.
puzzles.explanation: The queen and king work together: the queen gives check, and your king protects her.

puzzles.title: A wall of squares
hints: Your king already covers the squares in front of the other king.
puzzles.explanation: The rook covers the back rank while your king guards the escape squares.

puzzles.title: A little support
hints: Follow your bishop’s diagonal toward the king.
puzzles.explanation: The bishop protects the queen. The king cannot capture her or move to safety.

puzzles.title: Nowhere to go
hints: A knight can jump over the pieces around the king.
puzzles.explanation: The knight gives check. The king is boxed in by its own pieces.

puzzles.title: Two rooks, one plan
hints: One rook already cuts off the seventh rank. Use the other rook.
puzzles.explanation: One rook gives check along the back rank. The other blocks every escape to the seventh rank.

puzzles.title: The smallest piece
hints: Even a pawn can give checkmate. Look one square ahead.
puzzles.explanation: The pawn gives check, your king protects it, and the bishop covers the last escape square.

puzzles.title: A powerful promotion
hints: Promote on the back rank to give check.
puzzles.explanation: The promoted piece covers the back rank. Your king and the opponent’s pawn close off the exits.

puzzles.title: A royal fork
hints: Can your knight check the king and attack the queen at the same time?
puzzles.explanation: The knight attacks the king and queen together. The king must move, leaving the queen behind.

puzzles.title: A knight’s double attack
hints: Look for a knight check that also attacks the rook.
puzzles.explanation: Checking the king gives you time to capture the rook on your next move.

puzzles.title: A pawn with two targets
hints: A pawn attacks the two squares diagonally in front of it.
puzzles.explanation: The pawn attacks a knight and rook at once. When the rook moves, you can take the knight.

puzzles.title: Look both ways
hints: Look for a bishop check with a rook on the other diagonal.
puzzles.explanation: The bishop checks the king and attacks the rook. After the king moves, the rook is yours.

puzzles.title: A knight that cannot move
hints: The knight shields its king from your rook. Attack it with a pawn.
puzzles.explanation: The knight cannot move without exposing its king. Your pawn attacks it and wins it.

0:e1e7.text: The king can capture your rook. Instead, attack the pinned knight with your pawn.

puzzles.title: Follow the diagonal
hints: Trace the line from your bishop through the knight to the king.
puzzles.explanation: The knight is pinned to the king. Your pawn attacks it, so the knight cannot escape.

puzzles.title: The queen is pinned
hints: The queen is shielding its king. Your rook and bishop both attack her.
puzzles.explanation: Your rook and bishop work together to win the queen. They also protect one another on the capture square.

puzzles.title: An unguarded rook
hints: Look along your bishop’s diagonal. Is that rook protected?
puzzles.explanation: The rook is undefended. Your bishop can capture it safely.

puzzles.title: A knight’s opportunity
hints: Which enemy piece can your knight capture?
puzzles.explanation: The queen is on a square your knight attacks, with no piece ready to recapture.

puzzles.title: An open file
hints: Look straight up your rook’s file.
puzzles.explanation: Nothing stands between the rook and the undefended bishop.

puzzles.title: A new queen
hints: Your pawn is one step from the last rank.
puzzles.explanation: A pawn that reaches the last rank can become a queen.

puzzles.title: Answer the check
puzzles.objective: Stop the check. Win the rook.
hints: Can your bishop capture the piece that is giving check?
puzzles.explanation: Capturing the rook stops the check. Even if the other bishop recaptures, you have traded a bishop for a rook.

puzzles.title: Make room for your king
hints: Your own pawns block every escape. Move one to give your king some room.
puzzles.explanation: An escape square prevents a back-rank mate. When the rook gives check, your king can step out.

puzzles.title: A surprising first move
hints: Look for a queen check that pulls the knight away from the d-file.
puzzles.explanation: The queen draws the knight away. Then the rook gives mate, supported by the bishop.

puzzles.title: Closing the net
hints: Use your queen to take away the king’s escape squares.
puzzles.explanation: The first move limits the king’s choices. Then the queen and king work together to give mate.

puzzles.title: A queen’s quiet move
hints: Use your queen to take away the king’s escape squares.
puzzles.explanation: The first move limits the king’s choices. Then the queen and king work together to give mate.
